newsitem.title: USA: USDA's Haas calls Republican attacks political.
newsitem.headline: USDA's Haas calls Republican attacks political.

text.p: USDA Undersecretary for Food Nutrition and Consumer Services Ellen Haas said Tuesday that calls for her resignation were political.
"This is a political, personal, agenda-driven Republican attack on an undersecretary and an administration that has put families and children first," a spokeswoman for Haas said.
The statement came in response to calls for Haas' resignation from House Agriculture Committee Chairman Pat Roberts (R-Kan) and subcommittee chairman Bob Goodlatte (R-Va).
The two congressmen accused Haas of mismanaging USDA's huge feeding programs.

"After nine months of intense review, the GAO doesn't recommend any action or identify problem that we did not address well before GAO even began its review in 1995," Haas' spokeswoman said of a probe by the General Accounting Office.
